issues.description: Class name mismatch for the primary domain entity: the problem statement and the solution expect a class named Meal with the constructor Meal(String, String[]) and getters getName()/getIngredients(). The template repository instead provides an Order class with the same shape (Order(String, String[]), getName(), getIngredients()) and leaves src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java empty. The template Main also references Order in its examples while the solution Main uses Meal. This inconsistency (Meal vs Order / empty Meal.java) will confuse students and cause them to implement or call the wrong type or to encounter missing-class compilation errors when tests expect Meal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the starter template consistent with the problem statement and solution: provide a Meal.java in src/de/tum/cit/ase/ implementing Meal(String, String[]) with getName() and getIngredients(), and remove or rename the extraneous Order.java (or alternatively rename usages in the problem and solution to Order, but keeping Meal is preferred). Update the template Main and any other template files to reference Meal rather than Order so students can compile and follow the task without reconciling two names.
